Hymn 222: Hear Thou Our Hymn, O Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Frank W. Asper
Lyricist/Text Author: Frank I. Kooyman
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 222 titled "Hear Thou Our Hymn, O Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Frank W. Asper and the lyrics were written by Frank I. Kooyman.
